one_line: AI safety tools, funding flurries, school policy shifts, and new models dominate the day.

themes.title: Safety verification advances
themes.text: Anthropic released FlashProve, a cryptographic proof system for model replies, and researchers unveiled PEARL, a method that suppresses misaligned behaviors after fine‑tuning.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses
New PEARL method durably suppresses misaligned behaviors in language models

themes.title: AI funding and acquisitions surge
themes.text: Meta announced a cross‑border bond targeting AI and data‑center expansion, Fal reached a $16 billion valuation after a $1.3 billion round, Traversal raised $120 million at a $1 billion valuation, and CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million.

stories.headline: Meta targets at least $20 billion in cross‑border bond offering, debuting euro tranche
AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
Traversal raises $120 million at $1 billion valuation to expand AI‑driven site reliability engineering
CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million

themes.title: Google school AI policy changes
themes.text: Google said K‑12 admins can disable Gemini, NotebookLM, and AI features, but doing so also disables Google Search; schools that block AI will lose search access.

stories.headline: Google lets schools disable Gemini but forces AI in Search
Google disables Search for schools that reject its AI tools
Google lets schools enable Gemini, NotebookLM and Search separately after backlash

themes.title: New specialized AI models released
themes.text: The IndiaAI Mission unveiled three indigenous foundation models, OpenAI launched Daybreak Red for authorized cybersecurity work in AWS GovCloud, DeepMind’s Antigravity AI is being used for antimicrobial peptide discovery, and Qwen 3.8 27B demonstrated raw weight interpretation on a laptop.

stories.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models
Daybreak Red available on AWS GovCloud for authorized cybersecurity work
Google Antigravity AI accelerates antimicrobial peptide discovery
Simon Willison shows Qwen 3.8 27B can interpret raw model weights
